title: feat(spec)!: refuse a user field whose reference names an object other than sys_user; every user field resolves to sys_user
body:
Closes #24952

Clause-②: no (narrowing: a `user` field naming an object other than `sys_user` is refused; ships now under the amended 「甲」, #6015 `6303865025`)

The refusal half of #24808 (ruled A on #24854), re-timed to 18.x by the amended 「甲」 ruling. BREAKING: the accept set of `FieldSchema` narrows. Shipped as a `minor` changeset.

## What changed

- **`FieldSchema` refuses the shape** (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`). A field of `type: 'user'` whose `reference` names anything but `sys_user` gets one `custom` issue at `reference`. The message names the `lookup` spelling (`{ type: 'lookup', reference: 'TARGET' }` / `Field.lookup('TARGET', ...)`) and says that `deleteBehavior` must be chosen. Absent, blank and `'sys_user'` still parse. The check is on `FieldSchema` rather than as an `ObjectSchema` superRefine (the `refuseForeignTreeReference` precedent), because the verdict needs only the field. So objects, object extensions and `defineStack` all refuse it through the same code.
- **`referenceTargetOf` answers `sys_user` for every `user` field**, whatever the carrier says (`field-value.zod.ts`). A carrier that cannot be read still throws. A stored body saved before this release therefore resolves to `sys_user` as well.
- **`Field.user()`**: `reference` is now typed `'sys_user'` (still `@deprecated`) and is written after the config spread. The output keeps its key order and its literal types.
- **ADR-0087 D3 semantic entry** `user-field-foreign-reference-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.user-field-foreign-reference-refused.ts`). It is not a conversion, because the rewrite to a `lookup` is not lossless: a `lookup` joins the referential delete walk with `deleteBehavior: 'set_null'`, and `deleteBehavior` has no value meaning "leave it". `objectstack migrate meta` reports the entry.
- **The `@objectstack/lint` advisory `user-field-foreign-reference` is withdrawn.** It was added for 18.x and never published, and the parse refusal replaces it. Removed: the rule, its `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` entry, its export and its tests.
- **The 18.x pins are retired.** In `field-value.test.ts` (`my_people`) and the `object-graph.test.ts` explicit-carrier control, both now assert that the hop lands on `sys_user`. The `validate-object-references` unknown-object control is now proven on a `lookup`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/24952-user-field-reference-refused.md` (breaking, with FROM/TO, the fix and the ADR-0087 marker).

## The deleted pending changeset: confirmation needed

This PR **deletes** `.changeset/24808-user-field-foreign-reference-warning.md`, the pending release note of #24942. That note says `@objectstack/lint` exports `USER_FIELD_FOREIGN_REFERENCE` and that 18.x only warns. Both sentences become false in this PR, because the advisory is removed and the shape is refused. The note was never released: it is still pending on `origin/main`, so no published package carries it. `check-empty-changeset` is therefore **red by design**. This is the gate's DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, not a collision. The gate says the remedy is to state this on the PR and get it confirmed, and never to restore the note from base. **Please confirm the withdrawal.**

## Producers

The first act from the re-timing comment was to measure who writes this shape. A source grep over the tree (tests excluded) found no `type: 'user'` with a foreign `reference` in any app, example or package. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`, which parses the repo's example stacks, is green. So no producer needs fixing in this PR. Two test fixtures used the shape: the `object-graph.test.ts` module fixture was already a `lookup`, and the explicit-carrier control is rewritten here.

## Verification (head `bf738d1f99`, merged with `origin/main` at `63085c3806`)

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint^...' build` (spec and the rest of lint's dependency closure): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date. No regeneration was needed: no `.describe()`, authorable key or public export changed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local`: 706 files, 21433 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 72 files, 1237 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. This includes `check:test-typecheck`, which compiles the `expectTypeOf` pins in the new test file.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run`: 153 files, 7045 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` (every family recorded with its exit code): 91 derived, 91 run, 0 NOT MEASURED. 90 are green. The one red is `check-empty-changeset` (exit 1), explained above. `check:type-check-debt` first answered exit 3 (lock queue timeout), was re-run under the lock and answered OK, with 26 raw errors and none above its recorded number.

## Acceptance notes

- **objectui half of the card's item 6 is not in this PR.** `packages/fields/src/__tests__/userCell.readGate-10535.test.tsx` at the pinned `.objectui-sha` (`cf153eb2e5`) still pins that the user cell's person object is the field's `reference` (`crm_member`). The fixture casts its field and never parses it, so nothing here turns it red. But it now pins a reading the spec refuses. The renderer reads `reference` directly rather than the type's constant, so for a stored body saved before this release it would gate by a different object than the runtime resolves. Retiring it is a change in objectui, outside this claim's file surface.
- **The save door is inferred, not measured.** The changeset says the metadata save door refuses the shape. That follows from `object` mapping to `ObjectSchema` in `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-type-schemas.ts`. It was not measured over HTTP in this PR.
- **Contract review.** The claim says this PR owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review.
- Open PRs that touch `field.zod.ts`, `field-value.zod.ts`, `object.zod.ts` or the lint files in this diff: none (all 11 open PRs were read).
